title: SI-MET Recruitment 2026 – 9 Assistant Professor & Lecturer Posts
description:
The State of Kerala has initiated a recruitment process called
**SI-MET Recruitment 2026**
in order to fill
**9 faculty posts**
at SI-MET Nursing College, Tanur, Malappuram. As per the
**SI-MET Nursing College Jobs 2026**
, candidates need to have MSc Nursing degree with Kerala Nursing Council registration to apply. It should be noted that
**SI-MET Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026**
takes place at the institute under one-year contracts. Candidates willing to apply for
**SI-MET Vacancy 2026**
should apply by 5:00 PM on
**November 18, 2026**
. The above introduction provides a good opportunity for
**Government Teaching Jobs in India**
in the field of nursing education. The candidates willing to apply need to know the post wise eligibility, age criteria, application form fees and necessary documents.
  
  
Profile of the State Institute of Medical Education and Technology
  
  
SI-MET is an institute run by the Government of Kerala with the Minister of Health as chairman and the Secretary of Health and Family Welfare as vice chairman. The headquarter of SI-MET is located at Pattoor, Vanchiyoor, Thiruvananthapuram. Candidates looking for the most recent
**government job openings for teachers**
can get faculty positions in nursing colleges of SI-MET. Candidates who are following
**SI-MET Lecturer Recruitment 2026**
must know that the notice is related to the Tanur nursing college alone.
  
  
Faculty Vacancies for SI-MET Recruitment 2026
  
  
Post Name Place of Work No. of Vacancies Assistant Professor SI-MET Nursing College, Tanur 2 Lecturer SI-MET Nursing College, Tanur 7
**Total Vacancies**
**9**
Deadlines and Notification Details
  
  

* Notification Date: November 3, 2026
* Notification Number: B/333(2)/2026/SI-MET
* Last Date to Apply: November 18, 2026 (before 5:00 PM)
* Application Mode: Offline, by post or hand to the Director

Degree and Experience Prerequisites for SI-MET Recruitment 2026
  
  
Post Name Qualification Required Assistant Professor
  
  

* MSc Nursing
* 3 years of total teaching experience after MSc Nursing in a collegiate programme
* Valid Kerala Nursing Council registration
* Applicants of SI-MET Recruitment 2026 should match the experience rule carefully

Lecturer
  
  

* MSc Nursing
* BSc Nursing degree and valid Kerala Nursing Council registration
* No experience is mentioned in the notification

Maximum Age Allowed
  
  

* Regular Candidates: Up to 50 years
* Retired Personnel: Up to 59 years
* Minimum Age: Not mentioned

Monthly Consolidated Pay
  
  

* Assistant Professor: Rs. 33,320/- per month
* Lecturer: Rs. 32,450/- per month

Job Profile and Responsibilities
  
  

* Assistant Professor:

+ Teaching: Instruct nursing courses for students enrolling into courses at the college level.
+ Academic Counseling: Provide guidance to students in understanding the nursing theories and practices.
+ Experience: Employ teaching and nursing experience in academic activities.
+ Knowledge of Subject Matter: Help teach subjects related to the specialization in MSc Nursing of the candidate.

* Lecturer:

+ Instruction in Classroom: Give instructions in accordance with the assigned topics.
+ Support to the Students: Assist students in comprehending the theories of nursing and others.
+ Academic Tasks: Carry out the academic tasks in the nursing institution.
+ Professional Contribution: Provide postgraduate knowledge about nursing for academic purposes.

Fee Details for Applicants
  
  

* General Category: Rs. 250/-
* SC and ST: Rs. 100/-
* Method of Payment: SB Collect link at www.simet.in
* Alternate Method of Payment: Challan at any SBI branch

Engagement Terms for SI-MET Recruitment 2026
  
  

* Applicants fulfilling the required qualifications should forward the completed application form with the proof of payment of fees along with other supporting documents to the Director.
* The institute will reject applications that arrive after 5:00 PM on November 18, 2026.
* The institute will check the credentials, experience and Kerala Nursing Council registration of each candidate.
* The institute will prefer candidates from the districts of Malappuram, Kozhikode and Palakkad.
* There is no mention of any written examination or interview in the notification. The institute will intimate candidates regarding the selection procedure.
* The candidates selected for the position will be on a one-year contract, which will be extended on merit.
* The selected candidates will get into the Government Jobs in Kerala at Tanur under a one-year contract basis.
* SC/ST candidates should apply for the reservation through community and Non-Creamy Layer certificates.

Papers and Certificates Required
  
  

* Duly completed application form downloaded from www.simet.in.
* Applicant’s detailed biodata.
* Valid proof of age.
* Experience certificate, especially for Assistant Professor.
* Valid Kerala Nursing Council registration certificate.
* Certificate of BSc Nursing / MSc Nursing along with grade sheet.
* Caste/community and non-creamy layer certificates, wherever applicable.
* Remittance information, including the payment date and amount.

Preparation of SI-MET Recruitment 2026: Best Books
  
  
**SI-MET Recruitment 2026**
doesn’t make any mention of a written exam. Hence, it is not necessary for the candidates to prepare themselves for a competitive exam as a part of this recruitment drive. However, the candidates must develop an expertise in nursing subjects and fundamental concepts.
  
  
Subject Preparation Focus Nursing Fundamentals Review standard textbooks and core clinical concepts. Medical-Surgical Nursing Revise important medical-surgical nursing topics. Community Health Nursing Study community healthcare and public health concepts. Nursing Education Understand teaching methods and curriculum development. MSc Nursing Specialisation Revise topics related to your postgraduate nursing specialisation.
  
  
Benefits of Reviewing Previous Nursing Examination Papers
  
  

* Subject Revisions: Identify important concepts related to nursing and revise important subjects for study.
* Knowledge Analysis: Understand your knowledge base regarding special subjects of nursing.
* Concept Clarification: Improve your knowledge base about the concepts involved in clinical practice and theory.
* Professional Development: Make sure that you keep up to date with all the relevant information pertaining to SI-MET Nursing College Recruitment 2026.
* Academic Confidence Building: Increase confidence when discussing special subjects of nursing in professional analysis.
* Teaching Methodology: Learn the technique to present difficult concepts of nursing in an easy manner.

Career Growth
  
  

* Teaching Experience: Assistant Professors may be able to increase their experience in collegiate nursing teaching.
* Academic Skill Enhancement: Lecturers may be able to enhance their knowledge and skills as teachers in the subject.
* Institutional Recognition: Working in an undertaking of the Government of Kerala will provide institutional experience.
* Specialization: Faculties can become specialists in their fields of MSc Nursing specialization.
* Mentoring: They can become more effective as mentors of students.
* Research Participation: Academics can also make use of the experience to participate in research and learning activities.
* Career Advancement: Academic experience can help faculties apply for better academic positions, depending upon eligibility requirements for Kerala Nursing Faculty Jobs 2026.
* Networking: The faculties can establish contacts with nursing educators and healthcare practitioners.

Submission Process for SI-MET Recruitment 2026
  
  

* Visit the official website at www.simet.in
* Go to career section to find the Notification for the Post of Teaching Faculty positions for Simet Tanur.
* Careful study of the whole notice is suggested prior to filling up the application form.
* Use application form of Assistant Professor/Lecturer as per requirement.
* Stick the recent photo in the allotted space in the form.
* Fill in your details, qualifications, council registration and experience in the prescribed columns.
* Pay the required fee of Rs. 250/- or Rs. 100/- through SB Collect/ SBI Challan.
* State the date and amount of the fee paid in the form.
* Prepare the document and fee receipt in an envelop along with the application form and sign the declaration.
* Candidates for SI-MET Lecturer Recruitment 2026 need to state the post name in the envelop.
* Submit the application form to The Director, SI-MET, Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O, Thiruvananthapuram 695035.
* The application form should reach before 5:00 PM on November 18, 2026.

Key Points to Remember
  
  

* Offline Application Process: The application form with attached documents is required to be submitted to the Director, since there is no facility of submitting the application form online at SI-MET.
* Requirement of Registration: A valid registration from Kerala Nursing Council is mandatory for both these positions; therefore, this job recruitment is related to Latest Government Jobs in India.
* Last Date: The SI-MET does not accept the application form after the last date; therefore, applicants are requested to submit their application form before the last date.
* Contract Term: The term of contract is for one year and depends upon the performance of the applicant.
* Location Restriction: Both the positions are for Tanur and the candidates cannot be transferred to any other SI-MET colleges.
* Reservation: The applicants claiming communal reservation should attach the caste and non-creamy layer certificate along with their application forms.
* Mode of Payment: The payment could be made by SB Collect/SBI challan.

FAQs
  
  
There are nine vacancies in total, out of which there are two vacancies for Assistant Professors and seven for Lecturers in the Nursing College of SI-MET in Tanur, Malappuram, Kerala.
  
  
The minimum educational qualification is MSc Nursing degree. Candidates applying for Assistant Professor should have three years of experience in teaching after obtaining MSc Nursing.
  
  
The selected candidates will be paid Rs. 33,320/- per month for Assistant Professors and Rs. 32,450/- per month for Lecturers, in a consolidated amount.
  
  
The candidate has to make sure that the completed application forms get to the Director, SI-MET, Thiruvananthapuram, by 5:00 pm on November 18, 2026.
  
  
Official Links
  
  
**Official Notification**
**Download PDF**
**Official Website**
**www.simet.in**

title: Office 365 Email Support
description:
**Company Description**

We are a Doha based IT company with over
**25 years of experience**
providing professional website development, application development, web hosting, business email solutions, and IT support services to clients across Qatar. With our corporate office in Doha and a back-office development and support center in Trivandrum, Kerala, India, our dedicated team of
**15 professionals across Qatar and India**
delivers reliable, innovative, and cost-effective digital solutions. We focus on quality, customer satisfaction, and long-term technical support.

Role Description – Microsoft Office 365 Email Support Specialist

We are looking for a part-time, remote Microsoft Office 365 Email Support Specialist to provide technical support, license management, and troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 email services. Responsibilities include Outlook and Exchange Online support, mailbox configuration, user account management, and email migrations from cPanel, Google Workspace, and other email platforms to Microsoft 365. The role also involves DNS configuration, resolving email delivery issues, license activation and renewals, and ensuring smooth, secure, and reliable email operations.

**Qualifications**

1. **Microsoft 365 Expertise:**
   Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Exchange Online, Outlook, and mailbox management.
2. **Email Migration Experience:**
   Hands-on experience migrating emails from cPanel, Google Workspace, and other email hosting platforms to Microsoft 365.
3. **Technical Troubleshooting:**
   Ability to diagnose and resolve email delivery, Outlook connectivity, authentication, and mailbox issues.
4. **DNS & License Management:**
   Good understanding of MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and Autodiscover records, along with Microsoft 365 license management.
5. **Communication & Support Skills:**
   Excellent troubleshooting, customer support, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

title: Facilitator
description:
**Walking Ferns is Hiring Facilitators! 🌱 Share Your Passion for Learning with Us.**

**Do you love learning and being around children? If you believe children learn best when they are free to explore, question, create, and discover, we’d love to hear from you.**

**Through Walking Ferns**
, we have been curating study tours, camps, and workshops in active partnership with parents—creating vibrant learning experiences for both school-going and homeschooled children. Now, we are opening our first permanent learning center:
**‘Kuttinaad’**
near Kakkodi, Kozhikode!

**About Kuttinaad:**
It’s an environment designed for children to bond, play, understand nature, soil, and climate, and learn life lessons through experience. Beyond traditional classrooms, our activities focus on play, environmental observation, and hands-on science experiments. We aren't preparing kids for exam papers—we are preparing them to understand how the world works and live joyful, meaningful lives.

🔍
**The Role & Structure**

We are looking for energetic, patient, and dedicated individuals to join our core team as Learning Facilitators.

**Weekly Schedule (5 Days/Week):**

* **3 Days:**
  Facilitate weekly sessions directly with the children on-site.
* **2 Days:**
  Record observations, assess progress, and co-design future learning experiences with the team.
  *(Initially, starting with weekends with a transition to full-time/weekdays is also possible.)*



**Key Highlights:**

* **No specific qualifications or prior experience required:**
  We’ll train and support you as you learn alongside the children.
* **Direct Mentorship:**
  You will be trained directly by
  **Gautham**
  , founder of Walking Ferns and a leading voice in Kerala’s alternative education movement through
  **Sarang**
  .
* **Location & Travel:**
  Based initially at
  **Kuttinaad (Kakkodi, Kozhikode)**
  . As we expand with upcoming centers near
  **Chalakudy**
  and
  **Trivandrum**
  , facilitators may have the opportunity to travel between these centers.

📩
**How to Apply:**
Send your resume and a short note about why you’d love to work with children to
**contact@walkingferns.in**
, or drop us a direct message here!

*Come learn, grow, and create with us.*

**#Hiring #AlternativeEducation #LearningFacilitator #WalkingFerns #Kuttinaad #KozhikodeJobs #Chalakudy #Trivandrum #ExperientialLearning #EducationJobs**

title: Control Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Controls Engineer / Sr. Controls Engineer** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 Looking for a
 **Controls Engineer / Sr. Controls Engineer / Automation Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI development, industrial automation and commissioning.
 



 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with
 **Siemens PLC and HMI programming** 
 , automotive assembly processes, robot integration and industrial automation systems.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and program
 **PLC and HMI applications** 
 .
* Test, validate and troubleshoot PLC/HMI software to ensure commissioning readiness.
* Develop operator visualisation screens using platforms such as
 **Weintek, AutomationDirect** 
 , etc.
* Support commissioning teams with technical troubleshooting and software\-related issues.
* Provide technical support to commissioning teams working in
 **North America** 
 .
* Prepare technical and non\-technical documentation as required for project deliverables.
* Support automation system standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Troubleshoot and resolve automation, controls and communication\-related issues.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary and remote engineering teams to achieve project objectives.

* In\-depth knowledge of
 **Siemens PLC and HMI programming** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience in programming and commissioning
 **robotic automation systems in the automotive manufacturing domain** 
 , particularly

 .

* Strong knowledge of

 for applications including:

* Arc welding

* Projection welding
* Material handling
* Experience with industrial automation systems and commissioning.



**Additional Technical Skills** 



* Knowledge of

 .

 .

 configuration and programming.

 .

 **FANUC, KUKA or ABB** 
 will be an added advantage.
* Basic programming knowledge in technologies such as:
* XML
* C\#
* JScript
* VBA
* Python
* will be an advantage.
* Experience in
 **plastic welding** 
 will be an added advantage.



**Educational Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in:
* Electrical Engineering
* Electronics Engineering
* Instrumentation Engineering
* Mechatronics Engineering



**Preferred Experience** 



* **5–12 years of relevant experience** 
 in programming and commissioning of robotic automation systems in the
 **automotive manufacturing domain** 
 , particularly
 **BIW or General Assembly** 
 .
* Experience with a
 **system integrator** 
 is preferred.
* Alternatively, candidates with strong experience in commissioning and troubleshooting automation systems in

* Experience in automotive manufacturing and robotic automation will be an advantage.



**Location Preference** 



* Candidates from

 , as this is a

 .

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Quick learner with strong functional and technical expertise.
* Ability to work effectively with
 **intercultural, multidisciplinary and remote teams** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to organise, plan, prioritise and execute projects effectively.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a project team.
* Willingness to support international commissioning and project requirements.



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should be a hands\-on
 **Controls/Automation Engineer**

 Candidates who have worked with
 **automotive assembly lines, BIW weld cells, PLC\-robot communication, industrial networks and safety systems**

title: Automotive Technician
description:
**Company Description** 
 MUTHOOT AUTOMOBILE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED is an automotive services company headquartered at Muthoot Centre on Punnen Road in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India. The company operates within the broader Muthoot Group ecosystem, focusing on providing reliable and professional automobile solutions to a diverse customer base. It is positioned to serve both individual vehicle owners and business clients with a range of maintenance and repair services. Team members benefit from working in an established organization with opportunities to develop technical skills and contribute to high\-quality customer service.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Automotive Technician role based in Kanayannur. The Automotive Technician will perform routine vehicle inspections, diagnose mechanical issues, and carry out scheduled maintenance such as oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks. The role includes executing general automotive repairs, working on suspension systems, and ensuring all maintenance and repair work meets safety and quality standards. The technician will document work performed, maintain tools and equipment, and coordinate with service advisors or supervisors to provide clear updates and timelines for customers. The role also involves following workshop procedures, adhering to safety regulations, and supporting a clean, organized service environment.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in Vehicle Maintenance and routine Maintenance \& Repair tasks.
* Hands\-on experience with Oil Changes and related periodic service activities.
* Proficiency in Automotive Repair, including basic mechanical diagnostics and correction.
* Knowledge of Suspension systems and ability to inspect, repair, or replace suspension components.
* Relevant technical certification or diploma in automotive engineering or vehicle mechanics.
* Ability to read and interpret service manuals, technical diagrams, and work orders.
* Attention to detail, commitment to safety, and ability to work effectively in a workshop team.
* Prior experience as an automotive technician or mechanic in a service center environment is preferred.
